answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network maps all interactions onto an atlas graph where agents stake security deposits. If multi-agent auditing detects a dense cluster mimicking honest consensus like an isolated lagoon, topological cut verifications identify the bottleneck. Validating agents slash the bounded Sybils' stake, which is anchored like shale in the protocol, imposing superlinear attacker cost O(N^2) to fabricate valid cuts.
